text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The path to glory that was supposed to have been severed.
Yet, she...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Small wishes gathered one by one,
and they've carved out a path for me once again...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The grand finale of this spring—the Takarazuka Kinen!
This ticket was given to me by the fans
who never gave up on me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I definitely won't let it go to waste, Trainer!
I'll show you my absolute best race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In the past, I just scraped together luck and gambled on it.
Divination was all I relied on. But...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"What rests in my hands right now are the feelings of so many fans!
Feelings far stronger than ever before!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My desire to win, and the fans'
wishes for my victory...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
With a topping of good luck on top of that,
we'll have nothing left to fear!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
In this race—I won't leave it to luck,
I'll run by my own will!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
R-Right, exactly. I kind of thought so
myself~. Definitely went too far, too far...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Still! My feelings are the real deal. I'll make sure to pull off an auspicious winning ticket at that lottery!
